pages.title: Legendary Survival Overhaul
pages.text: Legendary Survival Overhaul (LSO) is a survival mechanics overhaul that manages its own status effect system. Because LSO and Nourished would conflict when both try to apply effects simultaneously, $(#e05252)Nourished's bonus and penalty effects are disabled$() when LSO is installed.

pages.title: What Still Works
pages.text:
Even with effects disabled, the following Nourished systems work exactly as normal:

$(bold)All six nutrition bars$() — track and decay as usual.
$(bold)Diet Screen$() — fully functional.
$(bold)HUD overlay$() — fully functional.
$(bold)Food tooltips$() — freshness, family, group all shown.
$(bold)Diminishing returns$() — still applies to nutrition gain.
$(bold)Sleep Bonus$() — still applies if configured.

pages.title: What Is Disabled
pages.text:
The following are suppressed to avoid conflicts with LSO:

$(bold)Per-group bonuses$() — e.g. Proteins max health, Grains XP gain.
$(bold)Per-group penalties$() — e.g. Fruits health reduction, Dairy knockback.
$(bold)Balance Bonus$() — the combined all-groups buff.

LSO handles survival effects through its own systems instead. Keeping your bars healthy still matters — it feeds into LSO's own calculations.

pages.title: Why Keep Bars Healthy?
pages.text:
Even without Nourished's direct effects, your nutrition bars still feed data into LSO's survival systems. A well-balanced diet contributes positively to LSO's stamina, resilience, and recovery mechanics.

Think of Nourished as the $(bold)nutrition tracking layer$() and LSO as the $(bold)effects layer$() — they work together rather than duplicating each other.
